_description: Ground-truth anomaly labels for the CloudIntelliGuard demo dataset.
_notes: Labels are human-assigned based on observable behavioral patterns in the demo data.
U006: Off-hours access (02:00-04:30 UTC), high IAM and Secrets Manager access, elevated failure rate (7/21 = 33%).
U007: Extremely high request frequency (40 requests in ~30 minutes), broad reconnaissance pattern across 8+ services.
U001-U005: Normal working-hours access, single-service patterns, zero failures.
These labels are for evaluation purposes only. Do NOT use to claim real attack detection.

observable_indicators: very high frequency (40 requests in ~31 minutes)
broad multi-service access (s3, ec2, lambda, dynamodb, secretsmanager, rds, kms, iam, sqs, sns)
reconnaissance-like pattern across 10+ different service types

coordinated_pairs.evidence_note: Factual temporal and service overlap only. No causal relationship claimed.
